data.name: DestinationInvalid
data.value: The destination must be an absolute http or https URI.

data.name: DestinationPrefixInvalid
data.value: The destination prefix must be an absolute http or https URI without a query, a fragment or user information.

data.name: PathNotNormalized
data.value: The path must be normalized with HttpForwarder.TryNormalizePath before a destination is built from it.

data.name: RequestContentReused
data.value: The client's request body can be sent only once, and the invoker asked for it again.

data.name: ViaPseudonymInvalid
data.value: A Via pseudonym must be an HTTP token.
